protocol.split_rule: global train-only random 80/20; same split across partition conditions
protocol.dirichlet_rule: existing multi-label random-positive-primary-label partition with minimum size 10; not independent per-label Dirichlet
protocol.imbalance_rule: label-independent lognormal sigma=1.5 sizes, minimum 20; all examples retained
protocol.scope: frozen cached features; serial clients within each job, possibly concurrent independent jobs; no feature extraction time

timing_scope: attempt wall time; stage durations may originate from prior attempts; concurrent accuracy jobs are not isolated speed benchmarks
cost_scope: recorded algorithm uplink only; no downlink, wire framing or feature extraction; independent controls included in wall time, inspect stages
